remarks: Welcome to your next home sweet home! This charming single-family residence features three comfortable bedrooms and two full baths, offering plenty of space for families, roommates, or anyone who loves to spread out. Enjoy the convenience of your own washer and dryer-no more laundromat runs! Step inside to discover an expansive living room, perfect for movie nights or entertaining guests. The open layout flows seamlessly into a spacious dining area and kitchen, making it easy to host everything from casual brunches to holiday feasts. Outside, you'll find a private yard-ideal for summer BBQs, gardening, or simply relaxing in your outdoor oasis. Commuters will love the quick access to the highway, making their daily drive a breeze.  Please note: the landlord requires a credit score of 630 or higher. Don't miss your chance to call this wonderful house your home-schedule a tour today!
